jd:
About Us
Fourth Coffee Logistics moves specialty coffee from 40 roasters to 900 cafes. We are a friendly, fast-growing team.

What You Will Do
- Build and maintain Python and SQL pipelines that consolidate carrier, invoice and shipment data
- Design Power BI dashboards tracking on-time delivery, lane cost and carrier performance for operations managers
- Improve data quality: deduplicate carrier records, standardize units and validate delivery dates
- Pull shipment events from carrier REST APIs and join them to internal orders
- Partner with operations and finance stakeholders to define KPIs and turn recurring questions into self-serve reports
- Forecast weekly shipment volume to support capacity planning

Qualifications
- Experience with SQL and Python (pandas) for data cleaning and transformation
- Experience building dashboards in Power BI or Tableau
- Understanding of logistics or supply chain operations
- Familiarity with time series forecasting

Nice to Have
- Experience with dbt or Airflow
- Experience with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery

What We Offer
- Health and dental benefits from day one
- Hybrid work, 2 days a week in office

Equal Opportunity
Fourth Coffee Logistics is an equal opportunity employer and provides accommodation on request.
